answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 50201 Country: India Title: Regarding salaat and applying moisturizers like Vaseline? Question: Since it is winter, can I apply Vaseline moisturizers after wudhu and perform salat and recite the Quran? Answer ID: 50201 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 275/243/H=02/1435) You can apply Vaseline after wudhu and perform salah. You may also recite the Quran after applying it. Applying Vaseline may not break wudhu. If you have any other doubt, please write it clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
